newsitem.title: INDONESIA: BANK INDONESIA TO ABOLISH BAND ANNOUNCEMENTS.
newsitem.headline: BANK INDONESIA TO ABOLISH BAND ANNOUNCEMENTS.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, said on Thursday it will no longer announce its daily intervention and conversion bands with immediate effect.

"The government has decided effective from today, August 14, the announcement of intervention and conversion bands, which are usually announced at 3 p.m. local time (0800 GMT) will be abolished," Djakaria, head of the foreign exchange department told Reuters.
"Export bill discount facilities for Thursday remain as usual, using rates from August 13 (Wednesday)," he said.
"Bank note transactions with Bank Indonesia will stay but the time will be changed to 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. local time with rates to be announced at 2 p.m. local time on the same day," he said.
